༄༅/ /gtor 'bul dang sde brgyad 'bum bskul bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtor 'bul dang sde brgyad 'bum bskul bzhugs so/ /

phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du/ /nang bcud sems can gtor mas gang*/ /skye 'chi med par mchod par 'bul/ /phyi nam mkha' yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /nang 'byung ba bzhi yi gtor mas gang*/ /rang gsal rang dag mchod pa 'bul/ /bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i gtor gzhong du/ /theg pa rim dgu'i gtor mas gang*/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs mchod pa 'bul/ / bka' pha rol phyin pa'i gtor zhong du/ /sa bcu dag pa'i gtor mas gang*/ /phyi nang med par mchod pa 'bul/ /kun bzang yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad gtor mas gang*/ /'phel 'grib med pa'i mchod pa 'bul// lus ngag yid gsum gtor gzhong du/ /sku gsum yongs rdzogs gtor mas gang*/ /brjod du med pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /skye 'gags med pa'i gtor gzhong du/ /rig pa tshogs drug gtor mas gang*/ /'gags pa med pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sems nyid gnyug ma'i gtor gzhong du/ /sha khrag don snying gtor mas gang*/ /chags zhen med pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /shu bhaṃ/ ༈ phyi 'chi bdag gshin rje man chad nas/ /las kyi gshin rje yan chad la/ /gshin rje 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /'dir gshegs sha khrag mchod pa 'bul/ /snang srid lha 'dres bzhes su gsol/ /bsngos pa tsam gyis tshims gyur cig /bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub gyur cig /mchog gi dngos grub thob par shog /e ka tsa ti man chad nas/ /srid pa'i ma mo yan chod la/ /ma mo 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /gza' chen brgyad po man chad nas/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad yan chod la/ /sde brgyad dregs pa 'bum gyis bskor/ /dga' bo 'jog po man chad nas/ /klu bdud mgo dgu yan chod la/ /klu bdud 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /yam shud dmar po man chad nas/ /skyes bu lung btsan yan chod la/ /btsan dmag 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /rgyal po pe har man chad nas/ /'gong po spun dgu yan chod la/ /'gong po 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/

/ya bdud rgyal po man chod nas/ /nag po trag med yan yod la/ / bdud dmag 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /ma bdud rgyal mo man chod nas/ /bdud mo nag mo yan chod la/ /bdud mo 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ / bstan ma bcu gnyis man chad nas/ /grong yul 'dre mo yan chod la/ /'dre mo 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /skye gnas pha ma man chod nas/ /lan chags gnod byed yan chod la/ /lan chags 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /gung gi rgyal mo man chod nas/ /gza' yi sman mo yan chod la/ /sman mo 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /'dir byon sha khrag mchod pa 'bul/ /snang srid lha 'dres bzhes su gsol/ /bsngos pa tsam gyis tshims gyur cig /bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub gyur cig /mchog gi dngos grub thob par shog / sde brgyad 'bum bskul lags so/ /dri med 'od zer gyis mdzad pa dge 'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)gcod kyi spyi khrid chen mo/ - PAGE 284 -- PAGE 285 -- PAGE 283 -
